critique:director.verdict:
⚠️ DEGRADED: single-context (no sub-agent tool exposed, so Assessment A and the detector/browser pass ran in sequence in one context). Detector: `impeccable detect --json` on apps/web/src/{app,components} found 0 issues. It cannot catch the token-level patterns below (mono meta lines, eyebrows, more than one ink primary), so those come from reading screenshots.

Setup: reset to faef3c0, cloned node_modules, `next build` passed, `next start -p 4451`. Throwaway Playwright scripts signed up demo families through the real UI with Maya (grade 3) and Leo (K), plus one run through the "Stuck on homew

findings.where: / (all viewports): 'For parents' section links 'Privacy notice' / 'Terms of use' and footer 'Privacy' / 'Terms'. Source: apps/web/src/components/landing/Sections.tsx:184-188, Landing.tsx footer
findings.problem: /privacy and /terms do not exist in the build: no route in src/app, and both return 404 'This page isn't here'. A parent checking privacy before giving a child's details hits a dead end, right under a paragraph that promises 'Privacy, plainly'.
findings.fix: Ship app/(bare)/privacy/page.tsx and terms/page.tsx in the landing's reading column (even short, dated, plain-language versions), or remove both links until they exist. Add both routes to e2e/landing.spec link checks.

findings.where: / hero door 'Stuck on homework right now?' → /sign-up?goal=help → /profiles → /home → /talk (1440, 390, 320)
findings.problem: The door promises 'The tutor works through it with them, one question at a time'. After sign-up and adding a learner, goal=help lands on the same /home as every other goal: daily plan first, with 'Get help now' only as a secondary pill. On /talk, typing a homework question gets 'I'm the demo tutor, so I can't talk about it freely yet.' The first door breaks the product's own rule that the landing only promises what works that day.
findings.fix: Make the door tell the truth on a no-AI deployment: 'Type or photograph the problem; we match it to a checked practice set with hints and worked steps.' Route goal=help straight to a homework-first screen after the learner is picked (talk with a 'Paste the problem' composer, or the matched practice set), not /home. Swap the copy automatically when AI is on.

findings.where: /learn/{course}/first-next-last as K learner Leo (1440, 390, 320): scenes 1 'Stories go in order', 2 'Ana's seed', 3 'Put Ana's story in order'
findings.problem: The kindergartner's first suggested lesson is all text: sentences with speaker buttons, and the sort task is text sentences with First/Next/Last text pills. There is no picture of the seed, the watering or the sprout. For a child who can't read this is audio-only, and it contradicts DESIGN K–2 'picture first' and the landing line 'In K–2, every problem starts with a picture'.
findings.fix: Draw three SVG story cards (seed in dirt, watering can, sprout) from the palette. Make the sort a tap-a-picture-then-tap-a-slot interaction into First/Next/Last wells, with the sentence as caption and read-aloud. Put a picture on every K–2 LOOK scene before text.

findings.where: /practice, /growth, /home as K learner (1440, 390)
findings.problem: Outside the hero problem and the practice tiles, K–2 mode is 'bigger plus speaker buttons'. /practice shows the same grade-map rows as grade 3, with codes K.CC.B.5 and a 'Practice anything' box whose placeholder is 'Try fractions, telling time, nouns, density…'. /growth is a six-cell stat ledger with timestamps and 'Minutes'. Home plan rows are text-only, with '5 min' and '10 min a day', although DESIGN says no clock or timer in K–2.
findings.fix: K–2 practice: picture tiles (one per skill, drawn from its first problem) with read-aloud, no codes, no search. K–2 growth: a short picture list of what they did today. Hide minutes and the 'min a day' meta when data-band=k2.

findings.where: /home (K) 'Pick something to learn' tiles; /courses cards; /home 'Not sure what to learn?' card (all viewports)
findings.problem: Course thumbnails are placeholders standing in for content. 'First, next, last' and 'Finding the main idea' show grey-line skeleton cards that read as a loading state. 'Solid, liquid, gas' is a 4×5 grid of green dots (DESIGN bans generic dots). 'Adding on the number line' carries ~4px unreadable 0/5/10 labels. A kindergartner can't tell what any tile is about.
findings.fix: Render each thumbnail from the course's own first teaching visual at thumbnail scale: seed-to-sprout strip, ice/water/steam, a number line with 2–3 large labels. Never use skeleton lines as art.

findings.where: /practice rows and 'Up next' card, /home suggestions (grade 3 and K, all viewports)
findings.problem: Common Core codes ('2.NBT.B.5', '3.OA.C.7', 'K.CC.B.5') appear on every row a child sees. They are noise to a 3rd grader, gibberish to a 5-year-old, and add a second mono token to every line.
findings.fix: Hide codes in learner views. Show them only in parent records, print, or a 'Standards' disclosure.

findings.where: System-wide: /home 'Today's plan' meta, /courses/[id] 'Not started · 12 min · 6 scenes' and '0 of 4 lessons finished', /family/[id] skill-map rows, landing 'Gr 3 · 4 lessons', lesson 'Scene 1 of 6', magic box '⌘ Enter', calendar day names
findings.problem: Whole phrases are set in IBM Plex Mono: mono as a 'technical' costume, the most recognisable AI-dashboard tic. Usage is also inconsistent. The same '0 of 2 done · 15 min a day' is mono on /home and sans on /family/[id]. Lines mix faces ('Not started·Grade 2 · 2.NBT.B.5', with a sans word, then mono, and mismatched separators). At 390 the /family/[id] skill-map meta wraps into ragged two-line mono.
findings.fix: Set meta in Instrument Sans with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Keep mono only for keypad digits, timestamps in tables, and printed records. Use one separator style (' · ') everywhere.

findings.where: /home 'Next', /practice 'Up next', lesson stage bar 'LOOK'/'TRY', /courses/[id] '● Math · Grade 3 READY-MADE', /home 'Not sure what to learn? Start with this'
findings.problem: Eyebrow and kicker labels sit above headings on almost every screen. The craft floor makes this the one outright ban and DESIGN repeats it, yet it is the default pattern here.
findings.fix: Delete them. The lift shadow already marks the next card. The scene type lives in the scene list's icon. Subject and grade go after the title as plain meta. Badge 'Ready-made' only where it disambiguates.

findings.where: /home (1440): rail 'New course' + 'Start' + 'Add and start'; lesson TRY scene: 'Check my answer' + 'Next'; landing: header 'Get started' + hero 'Another problem'
findings.problem: Two or three ink primaries per screen, breaking 'one ink primary per screen'. On the TRY scene, 'Next' is a full ink pill beside 'Check my answer', so a child is invited to skip the exercise.
findings.fix: Make rail 'New course' and the 'Add and start' card secondary. On TRY scenes, render 'Next' as ghost until the check has run, then promote it. After the hero answer, make header 'Get started' secondary or make 'Another problem' secondary.

findings.where: /practice/[setId] column addition (1440, 390, 320)
findings.problem: Three answer targets for one answer: dashed digit slots under the column, a rose dashed '?' in the '71 + 26 =' line, and a large '?' input above the keypad. The stacked digits are thin mono while the equation line is bold sans, and the '+' floats far left of the digits. A child doesn't know where the answer goes.
findings.fix: One target. The keypad fills the column slots right-to-left, and the equation's '?' mirrors the value. Drop the separate input box (keep a visually hidden input for keyboard and screen readers). Set column digits in the same face and weight as the equation, with the '+' aligned to the tens column.

findings.where: /practice/[setId] at 390x844 and 320x700
findings.problem: Actions sit under the keypad. Once 'Hint' expands, 'Check' is pushed below the fold and the child has to scroll to submit. A wrong answer is also wiped from the input, so the child can't see what was marked 'Not yet'.
findings.fix: Pin a bottom action bar (Check primary, Hint secondary) above the safe-area inset on phones. Keep the wrong answer visible, struck through with 'Not yet', until they type again.

findings.where: /profiles → Parent tile (1440, 390)
findings.problem: The grown-up gate ('Ask a grown-up / What is 9 × 8?') fades in at the bottom of the page under 'Manage learners'. At 1440x900, Cancel/Continue are below the fold; at 390 the input sits on the fold line. Tapping Parent looks like nothing happened.
findings.fix: Show the gate in place of the tile grid (same panel position), or as a native Dialog, since this is protected focus. Scroll it into view and focus the input.

findings.where: /calendar as learner Maya (1440, 390, 320)
findings.problem: The child's calendar holds parent admin: a Classes form (class name/subject/teacher), a 'What the teacher said' textarea with skill linking, and a 'Scores from school' form. That is four jobs on one page. The forms use dashed borders, which DESIGN reserves for empty states.
findings.fix: Move 'School' (classes, teacher notes, scores) to the parent view for each child. The learner calendar shows the week and one 'Add a test' action. Give forms solid hairline panels.

findings.where: /calendar at 390x844 and 320x700
findings.problem: An empty week renders as seven stacked empty day cards (~1000px of blank boxes). At 320 the week nav breaks: the next-week '>' button wraps onto its own line under 'October 5 – 11 < This week'.
findings.fix: With no events, collapse the week to one EmptyState row ('Nothing this week. Add a test') and list only days that have items. Keep prev / This week / next in one row (icon-only 'today' under 24rem), or put the nav on its own line under the title.

findings.where: /family and /family/[id] (1440, 390)
findings.problem: Each child card offers three routes to the same child: 'Open Maya's dashboard →', 'Open Maya's page' and 'See full record'. /family/[id] stacks ~9 sections (Today, This week, Skill maps, Coming up, Tutor conversations, Reading log form, Free places to find books, Settings for this learner, Where each subject starts): ~2500px on desktop, ~3500px at 390. Records contradict each other: Maya's card says 'No activity yet / No activity this week yet' while her page lists today's 3-message tutor conversation. Sibling cards differ in layout (Leo gets four cramped stat tiles with labels wrapping 'Right on / own'; Maya gets none).
findings.fix: One link per child ('Open Maya'). Split /family/[id] into Tabs: This week · Records · Settings. Count tutor conversations as activity. Use the same card layout for every child, with StatGroup in a hairline ledger.

findings.where: /talk user message bubble (1440; 390)
findings.problem: The child's message renders as a near-full-width solid ink bar (x 404→1076 at 1440 for 'I don't get fractions'). It reads as a giant primary button, and ink is reserved for actions.
findings.fix: Bubble w-fit, max-w-[80%], self-end, white or panel2 fill with ink text and a hairline. Keep ink only for the 'Start' action inside replies.

findings.where: / landing composition (1440: 6462px; 390: ~9450px; 320: ~10585px)
findings.problem: Below the strong hero, 'How it works' repeats one template five times (text left, demo card right, then a hairline), followed by skill map, courses, parents, status and close: generic feature-page rhythm and far too long for a phone at 9pm. The hero card's 'Try a real problem' heading is sr-only, so sighted parents get no invitation to try. On phones the card starts below the fold, and its grey '?' tiles and grey Check pill read as a disabled screenshot.
findings.fix: Show a visible one-line prompt on the card ('Try it: this is the real checker'). Move the parent-view demo directly under the hero, since it reacts to the answer. Cut 'How it works' to the checker and the tutor, and fold calendar and sources into one line each. Vary the composition rather than five mirrored rows.

findings.where: / 'Where things stand' card and tutor demo note; /settings 'AI tutor' and 'About this demo'
findings.problem: Parent-facing copy exposes deployment plumbing: 'When AI is connected', 'AI isn't connected on this site, so the demo tutor answers…', 'When this site is connected to an AI provider', 'This is exactly what works.' A parent doesn't know what 'connected' means. It reads like a staging banner and undercuts trust.
findings.fix: State the product, not the server: 'The tutor gives hints, first steps and worked examples on every problem. Open conversation about anything is coming.' Move live connection status to an admin/settings detail. Rewrite 'This is exactly what works' as 'Everything below works today.'

findings.where: /growth (1440, K learner) stat ledger vs /family stats
findings.problem: Growth puts the label over the figure; Family and the landing put the figure over the label. Labels wrap unevenly ('Lessons started' takes 2 lines), so the figures sit on different baselines (≈y287 vs y266). Six cells exceed a glanceable group.
findings.fix: One StatGroup order everywhere (figure over label per DESIGN), labels clamped to one line or fixed two-line height, at most 4 cells. Drop 'Minutes' for K–2.

findings.where: / skill map table at 390 and 320
findings.problem: Dot rows wrap. At 390, grade 6 Math '10 ●●●●●●●●●●' drops its 10th dot to a second line. At 320 every Math cell becomes a ragged two-row cluster. At 6px the dots are decoration on phones anyway.
findings.fix: Below sm, hide the dots and keep the numeral, or set nowrap with smaller gaps.

findings.where: / end of 'How it works' (1440 y≈663→776; same at 390/320)
findings.problem: Double divider: the last inner hairline is followed ~110px later by the next section's border-t, leaving a dead band between two rules.
findings.fix: Drop the trailing inner hr, or the section's top border, so one rule separates sections.

findings.where: /family/[id] Reading log form (1440)
findings.problem: Misaligned form row: the 'Author' label and input sit ~26px above Book/Minutes/Date because of its 'Optional' helper.
findings.fix: Use items-start with helpers below every field, or move '(optional)' into the label.

findings.where: /learn/* header at 390 and 320; desktop header
findings.problem: The lesson title truncates to 'First, n…' (320) and 'Halves and quarte…' (390) because three icon buttons crowd it. On desktop an unlabeled presentation icon sits between 'Read aloud' and 'Tutor'. The desktop scene list also truncates 'Put Ana's story in ord…'.
findings.fix: On phones drop the header title (the scene bar repeats it) or move the slides and tutor icons into the scene bar. Label the slides icon. Let scene titles wrap to two lines.

findings.where: Learner rail footer (1440, all learner routes)
findings.problem: A child's rail shows '1 – 6 switch tabs · Turn off' and 'Demo · tutor not connected': power-user and ops noise in front of a 3rd grader.
findings.fix: Move the shortcut hint behind '?' or into settings, and the tutor status to parent settings. Keep 'Saved on this device' only for grown-ups.

findings.where: /profiles avatars, rail and switcher (all viewports)
findings.problem: Avatars fill with brand rose (Maya) and the math subject blue (Leo). Rose is 'marks only, never a fill', and subject colours are 'never a full-bleed fill', so child identity collides with brand and subject.
findings.fix: Use a separate avatar hue set, or ink initials on panel2 with a 2px colour ring.

findings.where: /profiles after adding learners; /settings 'What we help with'
findings.problem: The goals picker says 'Pick any' but uses radio-circle indicators. It also sits on 'Who's learning?' and pushes the learner tiles down (two jobs on one page). Settings repeats it under a duplicate heading ('What we help with' / 'What should KaizenEDU help with?').
findings.fix: Use checkbox squares. Ask for goals at sign-up (the door already supplies one) and never on the picker. Use one heading in Settings.

findings.where: /courses (1440, 390); landing 'Ready-made courses'
findings.problem: An English grade-3 learner's 'Grades 3–5' grid includes the Spanish duplicate 'Fracciones: partes de un entero' with the same thumbnail. The 'No courses yet' empty state has no button. Card descriptions are cut off with an ellipsis. The landing course rows are inert text although the copy says 'Add one in a tap'.
findings.fix: Hide other-language duplicates unless the learner is bilingual. Give EmptyState its one action. Let descriptions wrap to two lines. Make landing rows open a preview, or remove 'in a tap'.

findings.where: / header at 320x700; footer nav at 390 and 1440
findings.problem: At 320 both 'Get started' and 'Sign in' are hidden, leaving only 'Español' in the header. Ghost-button padding pushes footer links ~14px in from the 16px gutter on phones and ~14px short of the right edge on desktop.
findings.fix: Keep a compact 'Start' link at 320. Add -mx-3 to the footer nav so text aligns to the gutter.

findings.where: Document titles: /home (K learner), /this-page-does-not-exist
findings.problem: The K learner's /home title is 'KaizenEDU' while grade 3 gets 'Today · KaizenEDU'. The 404 title is bare 'KaizenEDU'.
findings.fix: Set useTitle on the K home variant, and 'Page not found · KaizenEDU' on not-found.

findings.where: K–2 answer tiles on / hero and /practice/[setId] (Leo)
findings.problem: Choices render in IBM Plex Mono (slab-footed 1, mono 10). These are not the print numerals kindergartners learn. Each choice tile also embeds a speaker button, so it is unclear whether tapping the tile answers or reads.
findings.fix: Use Instrument Sans lining figures in K–2 choice tiles. Put read-aloud on long-press or one shared 'Read the choices' button rather than one inside every tile.

critique:access.verdict: Not ready to ship. axe found 0 serious or critical violations on all 60 page-views (20 routes at 1440, 390 and 320; the only rule hit anywhere is a moderate landmark-unique on /family). No route scrolls sideways at 320 or at 200% zoom. Reduced motion and forced colours behave well. But keyboard and touch use fall well below the bar. Two blockers: (1) on keypad practice sets a window-level Enter handler takes over every control. "Leave practice", Hint, Ask the tutor, Skip and even the digit keys can't be activated with Enter; Enter submits whatever answer is typed instead. (2) The landing page'

findings.where: /practice/[setId] (keypad sets, e.g. Ada 'Add two-digit numbers') · 1440/390/320 · apps/web/src/components/practice/AnswerPad.tsx useTyping (window keydown, ~L60-77)
findings.problem: A keydown listener on window catches Enter whenever focus is outside an input, calls preventDefault() and submits the typed answer. Checked: Enter on the 'Leave practice' link does not navigate. Enter on the keypad '7' button types nothing. Enter on Hint shows no hint and instead submits the typed answer (shown as 'Not yet. Try again, or take a hint.'). Enter on 'Ask the tutor' doesn't open the panel. A keyboard user who types 8, Tabs to Hint and presses Enter gets their answer graded instead of a hint. Backspace is caught the same way.
findings.fix: Only treat Enter/Backspace as pad input when the event target is not interactive: return early if target.closest('button, a[href], summary, select, [role=button], [role=link], [role=tab], [contenteditable]'). Better still, bind the handler to the pad/problem region instead of window. Add an e2e test that presses Enter on Hint and on Leave practice.

findings.where: / (landing) · all viewports · 'Privacy notice' and 'Terms of use' (Privacy, plainly) and footer 'Privacy' / 'Terms' · components/landing/Sections.tsx:184,187 and Landing.tsx:139,142
findings.problem: /privacy and /terms don't exist, so all four links give the 404 page (prefetch logs 'HTTP 404 /privacy?_rsc…' and '/terms?_rsc…' on every landing load). A broken privacy notice on a children's product, shown to every parent.
findings.fix: Ship app/privacy/page.tsx and app/terms/page.tsx (even a short honest demo notice), or remove the links until the pages exist.

findings.where: Every signed-in shell route with scroll (/home, /practice, /courses, /calendar, /family, /family/[id], /settings) · 390 and 320 · fixed bottom tab bar (AppShell nav.k-vt-tabbar)
findings.problem: Focus Not Obscured (WCAG 2.4.11 AA). Tabbing down the page scrolls each control just into view at the bottom edge, which is under the ~70px fixed bar. Elements caught under the bar while focused include: /home 'Fractions: parts of a whole' row, the textarea and the chips; /practice 'Practice: Subtract two-digit…' and 'Long division'; /calendar 'Add on Saturday' and the class/teacher/score inputs; /family child 'Date' and course select; /settings goal checkboxes and Save; /courses 'Add'.
findings.fix: Below lg, set :root { scroll-padding-bottom: calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) } (larger in the K–2 band, where the bar is 75px) and a matching scroll-padding-top for sticky headers.

findings.where: All shell routes · 390/320 · learner switcher sheet (#k-switcher, shell/Switcher.tsx, popover=auto)
findings.problem: On phones the switcher is a bottom sheet over a dimmed backdrop, but it is a non-modal popover. Tab after 'Sign out' moves focus to page content behind the backdrop ('Get help now', 'Open Ada's dashboard', 'Math'…) while the sheet stays open (screenshot confirmed). Escape and focus return work.
findings.fix: On phones render it as a modal (native <dialog>.showModal(), like kit/overlay Sheet), or make the page inert while it is open, or hide the popover on focusout. On desktop, hiding it on focusout is enough.

findings.where: /practice/[setId] · 1440/390/320 · 'Ask the tutor' panel (components/tutor/TutorDrawer.tsx Panel)
findings.problem: Opening the panel leaves focus on the problem h1: the Runner's heading focus overrides panel.focus(). The panel is the last thing in the DOM, so keyboard and screen-reader users must Tab through the read-aloud buttons and all 11 keypad keys to reach it. On phones it is a bottom sheet with a backdrop but aria-modal=false, so Tab moves through the hidden keypad behind it. Closing with the X sends focus to <body>, not back to 'Ask the tutor'. The X is 40×40.
findings.fix: Use the kit Sheet/Dialog (showModal) on phones. After mount, focus the panel's input or title and stop the Runner's heading-focus effect from running while the panel is open. Store the opener and restore focus to it on close (Escape and X). Make the X an IconButton md / size-target.

findings.where: / (landing) 'Real sources' cards (Fractions: Intro, Grade 3 math) · all viewports · components/landing/Faces.tsx:162; /home both learners 'What do you want to learn?' textarea · all viewports · components/magic-box/MagicBox.tsx:80
findings.problem: No visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7), confirmed in screenshots. The source cards use `outline-none focus-visible:outline-2` without outline-solid. In Tailwind v4, outline-none sets --tw-outline-style:none, so the focus outline renders with style none. The magic-box textarea has focus:outline-none and its form has no focus-within style.
findings.fix: Faces.tsx: add focus-visible:outline-solid, as kit/display.tsx already does. MagicBox: add focus-within:border-accent focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:outline-solid focus-within:outline-accent to the <form>, or drop focus:outline-none.

findings.where: Touch at 390/320 (pointer: coarse), grade-3 learner and parent: /practice/[setId] 'Leave practice' + read-aloud 40×40; /learn 'Back to course' 40×40; /talk 'Back' + read-aloud 40×40, topic chips and 'Read aloud' toggle 36px tall; /calendar prev/next week 40×40, 'This week' 40, day 'Add on …' 32×32, 'Download a calendar file (.ics)' 22px tall, 'Find a skill' input 40; /practice subject tabs 40, 'Find my level' 22; /family/[id] subject tabs 40, 'Family'/'Calendar' links 40; /settings English/Español 40, 'Settings and records' 20px; /family 'Open Ada's page'/'See full record' 40; /courses 'Open' 86×36; landing 'See the problem above in Spanish', 'Privacy notice', 'Terms of use' 22px
findings.problem: Below the project's 44px touch rule (CLAUDE.md rule 5, DESIGN.md 'small controls ≥44px on touch'). These controls use size-10/size-8/min-h-10, or text-link styling, without the pointer-coarse:min-h-11 that btn('sm') and k-chip have.
findings.fix: Route them through the kit: IconButton md / size-target for icon buttons (week nav, day add, back, read-aloud, tutor close), btn('sm') for pills (gives 44 on coarse pointers), and min-h-11 plus padding for text-style buttons and links on coarse pointers. Day-add buttons need size-target, not size-8.

findings.where: K–2 band (Leo) · 390 and 320 · read-aloud buttons on /home, /practice/[setId], /learn, /talk; 'Leave practice', 'Back', 'Back to course'; /practice subject tabs; /talk chips and Send; /courses 'Open'; lesson header Read aloud/Whiteboard/Show tutor
findings.problem: The task's bar is 56px in K–2. Measured: read-aloud 44×44 at 390 and 40×40 at 320; Leave practice/Back 44 → 40; subject tabs 44 → 40; Talk chips 40 → 37; 'Open' 40 → 37; lesson header icons 48 → 44; Send 48 → 44; plan-row 'Start' 48. Below 24rem these shrink because --spacing drops to 0.25rem and they are sized with spacing utilities, contradicting DESIGN.md's 'below 24rem … type and targets stay'. The read-aloud speaker is a K child's main tool.
findings.fix: Size K–2 controls with --spacing-target (3.5rem) rather than the spacing scale. Make read-aloud an IconButton md at size-target in K–2, and set min-h-target on K–2 tabs, chips, Back and the lesson header buttons. Keep the 320 rule from touching targets.

findings.where: /practice · all viewports (tab semantics); K–2 at 320 (overflow) · subject tablist Math/English/Science · app/(app)/practice/page.tsx:86-98; also /calendar parent learner tabs (calendar/page.tsx:91) and ImportPanel tabs
findings.problem: A hand-rolled role=tablist/role=tab: every tab is a separate Tab stop, ArrowRight does nothing (checked), and there is no aria-controls or tabpanel. At 320 in the K–2 band the pill row measures 16→323px, so 'Science' is cut off by the screen edge.
findings.fix: Use the kit <Segmented> (radio semantics, arrow keys, measured thumb), or <Tabs> with a real tabpanel, and let the row wrap or go full width under 24rem.

findings.where: /courses and /home course rows · 390/320 ('Fractions: parts of …' at 390, 'Fractio…' at 320); /learn header title · 390 ('First, next, l…', 'Halves and quart…') and 320 ('First, n…'); K /courses 'First, next, last' at 320
findings.problem: Single-line truncation cuts the only label of a course or lesson down to a few letters, because the READY-MADE badge and three header icon buttons take the space. A K learner, or anyone at 200% text size, can't recover the title (the header h1 is the page title).
findings.fix: Use line-clamp-2 / wrapping instead of truncate for titles. Move the badge under the title below sm. In the lesson header let the title take its own row on narrow screens, or fold Whiteboard/Tutor into one menu.

findings.where: All form fields (k-input: /sign-up, /family notes, /family/[id] reading log, /calendar class/note/score forms, /settings) and goal checkboxes (/profiles, /settings) · all viewports · globals.css .k-input border-border
findings.problem: Non-text contrast (WCAG 1.4.11). Field boundaries are #e4e3df on #fff (1.28:1) or on paper (1.23:1), so on the white sign-up card the three inputs are white boxes with an almost invisible edge. The unchecked goal checkbox circles are similarly faint (border-strong #cfccc5 is 1.6:1).
findings.fix: Give fields and checkbox rings a ≥3:1 boundary, e.g. a border colour around #8c887f on panel. At minimum add a 3:1 bottom border; keep the soft border for cards only.

findings.where: /talk · all viewports (both learners) · message textarea (components/tutor/TutorChat.tsx:344); K at 320
findings.problem: There's no visible label, only an sr-only label and a placeholder at 3.63:1 (text-muted/80). The accessible name is 'Ask about this problem' on the free-talk page, where there is no problem. At 320 in K–2 the one-line field cuts the placeholder off mid-word.
findings.fix: Show a visible label, or a placeholder at full muted (#6b6862, 5.5:1). Name it 'Ask the tutor' on /talk and keep 'Ask about this problem' only in the practice drawer. Let the textarea auto-grow to two lines on narrow screens.

findings.where: /practice/[setId] keypad · all viewports · Delete key (AnswerPad.tsx:34 uses <IconX>)
findings.problem: The delete key is drawn as an '×'. On an arithmetic keypad, next to a '+' problem, children and parents read it as the multiplication sign. Its accessible name, 'Delete', is fine.
findings.fix: Use a backspace glyph (left-pointing tag with an x, ⌫) for the key and keep aria-label 'Delete'.

findings.where: /sign-up (and /sign-in, auth layout) · all viewports · EN/ES toggle (components/LangToggle.tsx)
findings.problem: The targets are 38×32 and 36×32 on touch (min-h-8), and the buttons' names are the lowercase codes 'en'/'es' (uppercase comes only from CSS), so screen readers say 'en' or spell out 'e s'. There is no group label.
findings.fix: Wrap them in role=group aria-label 'Language', set aria-label 'English' / 'Español' (keep lang=), and make them min-h-11 on coarse pointers (or size-target).

findings.where: /home textarea (MagicBox placeholder text-muted/70, 2.99:1), /talk and tutor drawer input placeholder (text-muted/80, 3.63:1), practice answer box '?' (text-muted/50, 2.09:1) · all viewports
findings.problem: Placeholder and example text is below 4.5:1 (3:1 for the large '?'). The magic-box example is the only hint of what to type.
findings.fix: Use full --color-muted for placeholders (5.5:1 on panel); for the '?' use muted at full opacity or a well outline.

findings.where: / (landing) Try-a-real-problem · all viewports · Sheet.tsx feedback region + announce()
findings.problem: A right answer is announced twice: the inline aria-live div and the global k-live-polite region both say 'Right, with help.'
findings.fix: Keep one: drop the announce() call, or remove aria-live from the inline region.

findings.where: /home (both learners) · magic box
findings.problem: The accessibility tree has two 'Add files' controls: the visible button and the sr-only file input with aria-label 'Add files' (tabIndex -1).
findings.fix: Give the hidden file input aria-hidden=true (it is only clicked programmatically), or remove its aria-label.

findings.where: /home Today's plan ('Start' ×2), /courses ('Add' ×3, 'Open') · all viewports
findings.problem: Several buttons have identical names; screen-reader users browsing a list of buttons can't tell which plan item or course each one starts. /practice already does this right with 'Practice: <skill>'.
findings.fix: aria-label 'Start English: Letter sounds', 'Add Finding the main idea', 'Open Fractions: parts of a whole'.

findings.where: /learn/[courseId]/[lessonId] · all viewports · header back link
findings.problem: The visible text is the course title ('Fractions: parts of a whole') but the accessible name is 'Back to course' (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name), so a voice-control user saying the visible text gets no match.
findings.fix: Drop aria-label and add a visually hidden 'Back to ' before the title, or use aria-label 'Back to Fractions: parts of a whole'.

findings.where: /practice/[setId] K 'Count up to 10' · all viewports · dot visual alt
findings.problem: With one dot the alt text reads '1 dots in rows of five', which a K learner hears through read-aloud and screen readers.
findings.fix: Pluralise through t() with a _one key, as courses.progress_one already does.

findings.where: /family · all viewports (axe landmark-unique, moderate)
findings.problem: Each child's card has a region with the same accessible name, so the landmark list shows duplicates.
findings.fix: Name the regions per child, e.g. 'Ada's notes' and 'Leo's notes'.

findings.where: /calendar (WeekView/panel scrollIntoView, calendar/page.tsx:63) and tutor chat (TutorChat.tsx:224) · reduced motion
findings.problem: JS scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) bypasses the CSS scroll-behavior override, so these still smooth-scroll under prefers-reduced-motion. Every CSS animation and transition was confirmed suppressed.
findings.fix: Pass behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth'.

findings.where: Desktop 1440 · rail switcher popover (#k-switcher)
findings.problem: The popover has role=dialog but stays open when Tab moves past 'Sign out' to Settings, leaving an orphaned open dialog.
findings.fix: Hide the popover on focusout when focus leaves #k-switcher and its opener.

findings.where: /talk K learner · all viewports · topic chips
findings.problem: A kindergartner is offered 'Fractions', 'Finding the main idea' and 'How the Moon changes': the same grade-3 topics Ada sees.
findings.fix: Pick the chips by grade band (e.g. counting, letter sounds, seasons for K–2).

findings.where: /404 · all viewports; / at 320; /learn K desktop scene list; landing skills table at 390
findings.problem: The 404 document title is just 'KaizenEDU'. At 320 the landing header drops 'Get started'. The K lesson scene list truncates 'Put Ana's story in ord…' at 1440. In the landing skills table, grade 6's ten math dots wrap one dot onto a second line at 390.
findings.fix: Title 'Page not found · KaizenEDU'; keep a compact 'Start' CTA at 320; let scene names wrap to 2 lines in K–2; allow the dot strip to shrink its gap or show the count only below sm.

findings.where: Desktop 1440 (pointer: fine) · rail 'Turn off' 48×24; landing 'See the problem above in Spanish' 22px; calendar '.ics' link 22px
findings.problem: These pass WCAG 2.5.8 through spacing, but are the smallest hit areas in the app on a mouse.
findings.fix: Give text-style buttons min-h-8 or larger padding (py-1.5) on fine pointers too.

Front page and legal pages

- "How it works" is now two side-by-side panels (the checker and the tutor), plus one ruled line each for calendar and sources. There is a single rule between sections.
